text.en:
Barangays Talusan, Florida, Baganipay, Mahayahay, Laparay, Sagay, Kawilan, Samonte,
Kasigpitan, Bualan, Bolingan, Aurora, Tuburan and Moalboal, all in the Municipality of Mabuhay, Province
of Zamboanga del Sur, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and
separate municipality which is created to be known as the Municipality of Talusan without affecting in any
manner the legal existence of the mother Municipality of Mabuhay.
The new municipality shall be specifically bounded as follows:
"Beginning from point 1; intersection of Longtitude 122_53'43" and Latitude 7_19'47"; thence N 45_22'W
with a distance of about 12,800 MTS. until it intersects at point 2; thence due west a distance 1,000 MTS.
until it intersects and shoreline called point 3; thence following the shoreline moving northernly and easternly
a distance of about 7,400 MTS. until it intersects at pt. 4; thence S 14_24'W with a distance of about 3080
MTS. until it intersects point 5; thence S 57_W with a distance of 6,280 MTS. until it intersects at creekline
called point 6; thence following the creekline moving easternly with a distance of about 3,200 MTS. until it
intersects at shoreline called point 7; thence following the shoreline moving southernly and westernly with a
distance of 2,840 MTS. back to point 1 of beginning."
The seat of the government of the newly created municipality shall be in barangay Talusan.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereinafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the Municipality of Talusan.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Mabuhay shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Talusan until the municipal officials
of said municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office
until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal officials following the
issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such
appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel
of the Municipality of Talusan shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Talusan in the obligations, funds,
assets, and other property of the Municipality of Mabuhay shall be transferred by the President to the newly

created Municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Seven.
